lines.text: Samson spends the night in Gaza, then pulls out the city gate doors at midnight and carries them toward Hebron.
Samson falls in love with Delilah from the Valley of Sorek, and the Philistine lords offer her eleven hundred shekels of silver each.
Samson first says seven fresh bowstrings will make him weak, but he snaps the bowstrings when Delilah ties him.
Delilah ties Samson with new ropes, then weaves his seven braids into a loom while he sleeps, and he breaks free both times.
After Delilah presses him daily, Samson reveals his uncut hair, and she has it shaved, so the Philistines seize him and take him to Hebron.
